content: Multilingual NMT (MNMT) enables training a single model that supports translation from multiple source languages into multiple target languages, even those unseen language pairs BIBREF17, BIBREF18, BIBREF19, BIBREF20, BIBREF21. Aside from simpler deployment, MNMT benefits from transfer learning where low-resource language pairs are trained together with high-resource ones. However, BIBREF22 point out that MNMT for zero-shot translation easily fails, and is sensitive to the hyper-parameter setting. Also, MNMT usually performs worse than the pivot-based method in zero-shot translation setting BIBREF23.
